stages.name: setup
stages.message: Playwright Chromium installed and launched successfully; api.crossref.org and scai.confex.com/scai/2025/meetingapp.cgi both reachable (HTTP 200)

stages.name: crossref_discovery
stages.message: Fetched 3963 works for ISSN 2772-9303, filtered to 834 works for volume 4/issue 5, filtered to 805 session-coded abstracts (29 non-abstract works dropped: case reports, editorials, index/TOC pages), deduped 4 exact duplicate CrossRef records, sorted by page ascending, selected first 12 (OR1-1 through OR1-12, pages 102652-102663, fully contiguous with no gaps)

stages.name: confex_matching_and_extraction
stages.message: Matched and extracted full text for 12/12 abstracts from the Confex program via its search API. 11 matched by near-exact normalized title (score >= 0.99). 1 (OR1-12) initially matched a wrong record via surface-text similarity (a different abstract about in-stent restenosis that happened to share several leading words); corrected using token-overlap (Jaccard) matching on distinctive keywords, which correctly identified the true match (Confex Paper/36046, a Poster Abstract on bifurcation-lesion side-branch drug-coated balloons) and was manually verified by content.

stages.name: evaluation
stages.message: All 12 abstracts evaluated: 11 PASS, 1 PARTIAL, 0 FAIL

stages.name: completeness_check
stages.message: 12 entries discovered, 12 entries matched, 12 entries in final output, 0 duplicate abstract_id/doi_or_url values, every Step 2 discovery entry appears exactly once

stages.name: report_generation
stages.message: All output files written: abstracts.json, summary.md, validation_report.json

page_number_gaps: No gaps in the selected range: pages 102652-102663 (OR1-1 through OR1-12) are fully contiguous, one page apart each.
partial_entries: OR1-12 (DOI 10.1016/j.jscai.2025.102663, 'Drug-Coated Versus Uncoated Balloon for Side Branch in Coronary Bifurcation Lesions'): Confex program lists this under a differently-worded pre-publication title ('Drug-Coated Balloons vs. Plain Balloon Angioplasty for Side Branch Management in Coronary Bifurcation Lesions: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis', Poster D-92, Paper/36046) and as a Poster Abstract rather than the Oral Abstract session implied by the OR1 code. Combined title-similarity score was 0.584 (below the 0.75 light-normalization threshold), so it is flagged PARTIAL despite full_text being complete and clinically consistent with the CrossRef abstract (same topic, methods, and conclusions), because the match required keyword/content-level verification rather than light normalization alone.
other_observations: CrossRef returned 29 non-session-coded works within volume 4/issue 5 (case reports, editorials, an Author Index, and a Table of Contents entry) that were correctly excluded by the session-code filter.

CrossRef returned 4 exact-duplicate records (same DOI appearing twice: 10.1016/j.jscai.2025.102803, .103360, .103369, .103382) elsewhere in the full volume/issue result set; deduplicated by DOI. None of these fell within the selected first-12 range.
